title: Sample, Validate and Calibrate BirdNET Detections
text: select_clips() extract_validation_clips() take sampling_mode: "top" (default) keeps N predictions highest confidence per site x species x night x hour. serves retraining score--probability calibration (model conditional score). serve estimate false-positive rates: top-score clips hold fewer false positives random sample. "random_detections" follows observation-confirmation design Chambert et al. (2015): occasions least one prediction >= threshold drawn random within strata depend score, every prediction >= threshold drawn occasion cut. "random_recordings" follows multiple-method design Miller et al. (2011): recordings (minutes) drawn among recorded, without predictions, annotation ear. clip whole recording confidence NA. manifest records occasion_id, n_detections_occasion inclusion_prob (probability occasion drawn). Every draw uses fixed seed, rerun selects clips, cut idempotent: interrupted run resumes stopped.
